verdict.rationale: Finix is a payments infrastructure platform, not an agent or AI assistant, so acting as an MCP client that plugs in external MCP servers to use their tools is a category error for this product type. The evidence shows only that Finix publishes its own MCP server (the server role, for answering questions about the Finix API). That is a different story and does not make the client axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
